Aisha (CS): Heads up — spotted a bunch of "shadow" CRM records created during the new onboarding webhook test. Healthscore is double-counting events for some customers, gating playbook fires twice.
Priya (CS Ops): Ugh. Can you paste an example record id and the webhook payload you saw?
Aisha (CS): Sure. customer_id: C-4129. Payload had duplicate contact objects. Looks like our import retry created a second contact row with different contact_id but same email.
Marco (Data Eng): That's the classic idempotency gap. The importer doesn't dedupe on email. We should avoid merging blindly; could break external integrations.
Aisha (CS): Agreed. Need a short-term fix to prevent playbook double-fires before we push a proper dedupe pipeline.
Priya (CS Ops): Proposal: run a non-destructive scan that groups by email and lists accounts with multiple contact rows and recent onboarding events. Dry run first.
Sam (Platform Bot): I can run a read-only job. SQL snippet for dry run:
```
SELECT email, count(*) as cnt, array_agg(contact_id) as cids
FROM contacts
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY email
HAVING count(*) > 1;
```
Priya (CS Ops): Running dry run now -> uploaded CSV to /tmp/cs-shadow-scan-4299012345.csv (only team can access). I'll share sample rows.
Aisha (CS): Sample looks right. For C-4129 there are contact_ids [c_778, c_779] created 2m apart.
Marco (Data Eng): Ok for short-term let's add a playbook guard: dedupe trigger by email + onboarding_event_ts within X mins; if duplicate recent events, only fire once. I'll add a condition to playbook rules.
Priya (CS Ops): We can also add a retrospective reconciliation job: mark secondary rows as "shadow" (read-only flag) and exclude them from healthscore calculation.
Aisha (CS): Sounds good. What's the timeline?
Marco (Data Eng): I'll add the playbook guard and a feature flag today. Priya, can you run the reconciliation dry run tomorrow and surface edge cases?
Priya (CS Ops): Yep. I'll run it at 09:00 PT, post results here.
automation-bot: reconciliation-dryrun started by Priya at 2026-03-21T16:10:00Z :gear:
Sam (Platform Bot): Added feature-flag 'playbook_dedupe_email_guard' to the staging toggle list. @Marco please coordinate rollout.
Aisha (CS): Thanks team — blocking risk lowered. Follow-up: we should add a ticket for a proper idempotent importer (cross-team). I'll create and link it.
Priya (CS Ops): Link to dry run CSV: https://files.redwood.internal/tmp/cs-shadow-scan-4299012345.csv
Marco (Data Eng): Thx. I'll update the playbook rule and post PR link here.
Aisha (CS): 👍
